content.text: {"comps":[{"label":"C1","good":false,"reason":"Aftermarket parts, MRO and military shelters; it does not design or manufacture avionics flight systems."},{"label":"C2","good":false,"reason":"Trades, leases and repairs used aircraft and engines; no in-house avionics design or manufacturing."},{"label":"C3","good":false,"reason":"Industrial and medical motion control motors and drives; not aircraft avionics."},{"label":"C4","good":false,"reason":"Mainly industrial valves and pumps with a minor aerospace component line; not avionics."},{"label":"C5","good":false,"reason":"IoT cellular routers and device management for industrial customers; not certified aircraft avionics."},{"label":"C6","good":false,"reason":"Utility metering, filtration and test equipment; aerospace valves are not avionics."},{"label":"C7","good":false,"reason":"Network security hardware and subscriptions; no aviation avionics products or customers."},{"label":"C8","good":false,"reason":"In-flight connectivity service sold to airlines; it is a network service, not avionics design and manufacture."},{"label":"C9","good":false,"reason":"Industrial pumps, valves and friction products; aerospace is only a minor end market."},{"label":"C10","good":false,"reason":"Enterprise data storage and cloud services; no aviation or avionics overlap."},{"label":"C11","good":false,"reason":"HVAC, UV disinfection and detection instruments for buildings and utilities; not aviation."},{"label":"C12","good":false,"reason":"Custom foam and plastic components for medical and industrial OEMs; not avionics."},{"label":"C13","good":false,"reason":"Leases commercial aircraft engines and repairs them; asset leasing, not avionics manufacturing."}]}
